Contract therapy

Run the rehab department, not just fill it.

We take on staffing, scheduling, supervision and documentation for your therapy team, so rehab becomes a service line you can count on.

Talk to us about your department Therapy staffing

A good fit if

  • Therapy vacancies are limiting admissions

  • Documentation and productivity vary by therapist
  • You want one accountable partner for rehab

What we take on

The whole department, with one lead

Staffing

Physical, occupational and speech therapists and assistants, recruited and retained for your setting.

Scheduling

Coverage planned around your census, with cover for leave built in.

Documentation

Consistent, timely documentation that supports care and stands up to review.

Clinical leadership

A program lead who owns quality, mentoring and communication with your team.

How it starts

A careful handover

Assess

We review caseload, staffing, documentation and outcomes with your leaders.

Plan

A written transition plan with roles, timelines and the measures we will report on.

Transition

Existing therapists are kept informed and, wherever possible, kept on.

Operate

Regular reviews with your team, and changes made together.

Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

Which settings is contract therapy for?

Skilled nursing, inpatient rehab, hospitals, home health and outpatient clinics. The model is adapted to each setting.

What happens to our current therapists?

We aim to keep the team you have. The transition plan sets out how, and nobody is surprised.

Can you cover only part of the department?

Yes. Some facilities start with one discipline or one site and expand from there.
